Ruth, I couldn't set up the brief yet. The scheduler refused the job: it reports that the gateway needs credentials, and I can't fix that from this chat. I haven't created a schedule, so nothing will post at 07:45 tomorrow until it exists.

I checked the setup before trying. The three channels are different audiences, but everyone in #strategic-random (you, Gideon Sato and Nadia Fennimore) is already in all three source channels. So a digest posted there wouldn't show anyone anything they can't already see. The brief will leave out finance figures (rates, prices, contract values, payment terms) and will say a finance item exists without the number. It will also skip DMs and other channels.

To get it running, a gateway operator needs to configure the scheduler credentials. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll create the 07:45 Chicago daily job. If you'd like, I can also set up the same brief as a post you check by hand each morning in the meantime.
